title: Add, edit and remove
summary: Source-generated shared cases sync from clean, merged source and retain the full source revision. Deployment QA uses frozen candidate definitions and refuses source newer than the candidate. Exact failed-requirement correction isolates one host baseline; lanes use item-scoped or run-bound proof. A whole-plan edit (`yoke qa plan edit`) reads only the named plan, refuses a retired plan as plan_retired before the editor opens, shows every case field, including target_envs and stage_reason, and saves the document back whole; a save that leaves out an existing case's field and would reset its stored value is refused as qa_plan_edit_unedited_field_changed, naming each case and field.
